articles.title: A Bitcoin block just neared a 2015 transaction record, but paid only $180 in fees
articles.snippet: The AntPool block came within 984 transactions of Bitcoin’s 2015 record, even as fees made up less than 0.1% of the miner’s payout.

articles.title: Trump says he knows ‘nothing’ about World Liberty’s UAE ties as Justin Sun challenges filings
articles.snippet: Trump confirmed he co-owns World Liberty, whose UAE ownership could derail Justin Sun’s federal lawsuit over frozen WLFI tokens

articles.title: Zcash developers want 20-second blocks just days after major speed upgrade
articles.snippet: Early data shows Zcash's orphan-block rate holding close to pre-upgrade levels despite blocks arriving three times faster, encouraging developers to push for another reduction.

articles.title: Binance's bitcoin mining pool finds just one block in a week as shutdown nears
articles.snippet: The exchange's once significant mining operation has nearly disappeared from Bitcoin's block-production rankings ahead of its November 10 closure.

articles.title: Binance’s finance chief Kaiser Ng to leave company, report says
articles.snippet: Ng will be replaced by Justin Yek, who was formerly vice-president of finance at Airwallex.
